hero.subheading: A community-powered makerspace and enterprise hub helping people of all ages build confidence, skills, and real-world opportunities.

helpSection.heading: How can we help you?
helpSection.subheading: Whether you're a school, a young person, a family or an adult with an idea, there's a place for you in the Hive.

cards.title: ALTERNATIVE PROVISION
cards.description: Hands-on, practical learning for young people who thrive outside a traditional classroom, with referrals from schools and local authorities.

cards.title: WORKSHOPS & COURSES
cards.description: Make, build and learn new skills in our makerspace. Browse upcoming workshops and courses and book your place online.

cards.title: COMMUNITY PROGRAMMES
cards.description: From Makers to Market to outdoor education and wellbeing, our programmes help people of all ages create, connect and grow.

mission.missionText: Hustle Hive CIC empowers people of all ages through hands-on learning, enterprise and wellbeing. We provide alternative provision for young people, creative spaces for homeschool families, and skills, mentoring and resources for adults to launch businesses.
mission.visionText: To create a vibrant community hub where enterprise, education, and wellbeing connect, inspiring young people and adults alike to learn by doing, build their futures, and thrive together.
